messages:
sanjay: Hey team — PR #1456 is ready for merge (small revert+test fix). Want to land today if CI goes green. Target branch: release/1.12. Any objections to merging before the 18:00 PT rebase window?

emma: What jobs are still failing?

sanjay: windows-matrix is flaky, the rest look green. No functional changes besides the test tweak.

alex: @sanjay FYI windows has been timing out today. I can kick a rerun but if it repeats we'll need the short rebase slot or a canary plan. :eyes:

ci-bot: windows-matrix — job #7421: failed (timeout)
ci-bot: triggered rerun for job #7422 (requested by alex)

maria: Heads-up — we have a deploy freeze starting 18:00 PT for the infra patch. If we want to avoid freeze, merge needs to be in before 17:30 PT to allow canary checks. Otherwise we wait until tomorrow.

sanjay: Understood. I'm aiming for a 17:15 merge if windows passes. If it keeps failing, we should use the rebase window at 17:45 — anyone able to approve quickly? I need two approvals.

alex: I can review now, but I need one more approver (maria or david). @maria can you take a quick look?

maria: I'll review now. Quick note: please rebase to latest main before merging to avoid the CI flakes caused by the stale proto bump.

sanjay: Rebase done. Commands I ran:```bash
git fetch origin main
git rebase origin/main
# resolve a tiny conflict in go.mod
git push --force-with-lease
```

david: Looking — small, looks fine. Once windows is green I'll approve.

ci-bot: windows-matrix — job #7422: success

alex: Ran the full matrix locally for the relevant tests, all passing. Approving now. :thumbsup:

alex: @maria you good to approve?

maria: Approving. I'll give the final +1 once the merge is < 17:30 PT. If anything flakes again, we hold and use the 17:45 rebase slot.

sanjay: Thanks all — plan: merge at 17:15 PT if green, otherwise hold for 17:45 rebase window. Will post here before the merge and add a quick canary route after landing.

david: Sounds good.

sanjay: (after merge) merged at 17:14 PT, canary running. Will monitor 30m then promote.

ci-bot: deploy-canary — started for release/1.12 (build 2026-1777-canary)

maria: Monitoring logs — no errors in canary so far. Great job getting approvals quick. :tada:
